fields.description: Cash basis: income is recognised when payment is received (Profit First style, allowed for proprietorships and small businesses under IT Act s.145). Accrual basis: income is recognised in the month the subscription is for, regardless of when paid (required for most Pvt Ltds and partnerships under Companies Act 2013).
fields.label: Accounting Method

fields.description: Grace days after a membership invoice is issued before it is due (sets the Subscription's days_until_due). 0 = due on issue.
fields.label: Days Until Due

fields.description: When on, submitting an Expense posts a balanced Journal Entry (debit the category's Expense Account, credit the payment-mode cash/bank account). When off, a submitted Expense is a reference-only record and posts nothing. Requires an Expense Account on the category.
fields.label: Post Expenses to Ledger

fields.description: Prefix used to auto-generate Member IDs (e.g. "KE-", "FF-"). New members are named "{prefix}0001", "{prefix}0002", ...
fields.label: Member ID Prefix

fields.description: What a coach's "Percentage" commission is charged against each cycle. "Assigned Member Revenue": the percentage of fees collected this period from members assigned to that coach. "All Gym Revenue": the percentage of the gym's total collected revenue this period. "Per Member" commissions always use the count of active members assigned to the coach; "Fixed" commissions are a flat amount regardless of this setting.
fields.label: Percentage Commission Basis
fields.options:
Assigned Member Revenue
All Gym Revenue

fields.description: When on, approving a Coach Commission Run posts a balanced Journal Entry to the ledger (debit Coach Commission Expense, credit Coach Commissions Payable). When off, a run is computed and recorded for reference only and posts nothing.
fields.label: Post Commission Runs to Ledger

fields.description: Expense account debited when a commission run is posted. Set automatically by "Set up commission accounts".
fields.label: Commission Expense Account

fields.description: Liability account credited when a commission run is posted (what the gym owes its coaches). Set automatically by "Set up commission accounts".
fields.label: Commission Payable Account

fields.description: A membership is flagged on the Renewals list when its Next Renewal date falls within this many days. Also the look-ahead window for the daily in-app renewal reminder.
fields.label: Renewal Reminder Days

fields.description: When on, a daily background job raises an in-app notification listing memberships due for renewal within the reminder window. No email or SMS is sent.
fields.label: Daily In-App Renewal Reminder

fields.description: What this business calls a single scheduled session (e.g. "Class", "Batch", "Slot", "Lesson"). Used as the label throughout the app.
fields.label: Session Term (singular)

fields.description: Plural form of the session term (e.g. "Classes", "Batches", "Lessons").
fields.label: Session Term (plural)

fields.description: When on, a daily background job auto-creates the scheduled (recurring) classes for the coming days, so fixed batches don't have to be re-created by hand.
fields.label: Auto-generate Recurring Classes

fields.description: How many days ahead the recurring-class generator keeps sessions created (a rolling window).
fields.label: Schedule Horizon (days)

fields.description: Business vertical. Picks the default display-terminology preset; each term below can still be overridden per business.
fields.label: Vertical
fields.options:
Gym
Yoga Studio
Pilates Studio
CrossFit Box
Martial Arts
Dance School
Music School
Sports Academy
Coaching Centre
Other

fields.description: What this business calls a subscriber (e.g. "Member", "Student", "Client").
fields.label: Member Term (singular)

fields.description: Plural form of the member term.
fields.label: Member Term (plural)

fields.description: What this business calls an instructor (e.g. "Coach", "Trainer", "Sensei", "Teacher").
fields.label: Instructor Term (singular)

fields.description: Plural form of the instructor term.
fields.label: Instructor Term (plural)

fields.description: What this business calls a program (e.g. "Program", "Course", "Curriculum").
fields.label: Program Term (singular)

fields.description: Plural form of the program term.
fields.label: Program Term (plural)
